mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pmc_audit_log(actor_id, action, target_type, target_id, details, actor_ip) VALUES(#{actorId}, #{action}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{details}, #{actorIp})
mapper.select: SELECT audit_id AS "auditId", actor_id AS "actorId", action AS "action", target_type AS "targetType", target_id AS "targetId", details AS "details", actor_ip AS "actorIp", to_char(reg_dt,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "regDt" FROM pmc_audit_log ORDER BY audit_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
